description: This file implements API endpoints for user profile information retrieval, including fetching the current user's display name and querying user display names by user ID. It uses FastAPI, Pydantic models, and integrates with Supabase for database operations.

classes.name: CurrentUserProfileResponse
classes.description: Response model for current authenticated user's profile information.

classes.name: GetDisplayNameRequest
classes.description: Request model for POST /users/me to lookup a specific user's display_name by id.

methods.name: SupabaseClient get_supabase(settings=Depends(get_settings))
methods.description: Provides a Supabase client instance using configured settings.

methods.name: Optional[str] _resolve_current_user( supabase: SupabaseClient, authorization: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Resolves the current user ID from the Authorization token.

methods.name: CurrentUserProfileResponse get_me( supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Authorization"), user_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch the display name of the current user or a user specified by user_id.

methods.name: List[dict] get_display_name_by_id( payload: GetDisplayNameRequest, supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve display name for a specific user ID from the public.profiles table.

search-terms: get user display name by id

ctags.pattern: /^    display_name: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Display name from public.prof/

ctags.signature: ( supabase: SupabaseClient = Depends(get_supabase), authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="Authorization"), user_id: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.pattern: /^    source: str = Field(..., description="Where the display name was obtained from (profiles|met/

ctags.name: user_id
ctags.pattern: /^    user_id: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="Authenticated Supabase user id")$/

ctags.name: user_id
ctags.pattern: /^    user_id: str = Field(..., description="Supabase user id (UUID) to look up in public.profiles/
